title: the chieftain pack
description:
Modpack revolving around the recruits mod and compatible mods. Use it to fight your friends and and have fun ! create petty kingdoms, make alliances and wage wars !

the choice is yours
body:
## presentation:
This modpack contains mod such has recruits mod, smallships, armor/weapons and building mods to live a "medievial like" experience. A small modpack, ideal for medium computers, it features optimization mods to help with performances.

### importan mods:

-recruits mod, adds villager soldiers to fight your friends.

-small ships, adds boats to rule the seas !

-epic knights series, adds weapons and armors from the past.

-villager workers, add farmers, miners, and other workers to optain ressources for your village.

-ewewukek's musket mod, to have a blast.

-Dawn of time and garden trails, adds content to build in whatever historical style you wishes.

-alex's mobs, adds animals to make nature more interresting
